intro.text: A Fjordell priest, head arteth of the Derethi chapel in Kae until the gyorn Hrathen arrives and sends him home.

items.text: Fjon had lived in Arelon for about ten years. Some five years after he took charge of the chapel, Dilaf came from Naen with a crowd of converts, doubling Kae's faithful, and Fjon was so impressed that he made Dilaf an arteth, even though Derethi law did not allow it.

On reaching Kae, Hrathen dismissed Fjon at once, judging him too comfortable and friendly with the locals and too lax with his priests, and sent him back to a Fjordell monastery for retraining. Fjon was dismayed until Hrathen showed him Wyrn's orders: Arelon must convert within three months or be invaded. He then accepted and left.

During the fighting in Teod, Fjon appeared out of nowhere, stabbed Hrathen in the chest, and slipped away smiling into the crowd. Wyrn had ordered the killing as his penance, the price of being admitted to Rathbore Monastery to train as an assassin.

appearance.text: Short, plump and balding, he wears the red robes of a Derethi priest. His cluttered office is hung with paintings of nature.

personality.text: Genial and easygoing, he smiles and chats with the people of Kae and slips into speaking Aonic with them, until Hrathen scolds him for it.
